ValidationRule.description: Ensures required fields are populated when transferring to Engineering queue
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(OwnerId), Owner:Group.DeveloperName = 'Engineering', OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Reproduction_Steps__c)), ISBLANK(Troubleshooting_Steps_Taken__c), LEN(Troubleshooting_Steps_Taken__c) < 20 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cases transferred to Engineering must include reproduction steps and detailed troubleshooting documentation (minimum 20 characters).
